title: How Many Queens to BEAT Ding Liren?
summary: Tony plays the Ding Liren bot. Game 1 even (loss). Game 2 one pawn is replaced by a queen (2 queens total) and he wins with a ladder mate.
rules: After each loss replace one White pawn with a queen (h2 first — the extra queen operates from h2/g1).
win_condition: Checkmate Ding bot (took 2 queens total, i.e. 1 extra).

opponent.name: Ding Liren bot
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon Ding Liren: short black hair, smiling, dark suit jacket, light blue shirt

current_impl_issues: Impl kingplus t=Q (king + queens only) wrong; full army with pawn→queen swaps, starting even.
evidence: 0:02 'first game will be even and every game I will replace one Pawn with a queen'; 11:36 'move my queen back to H2... G1'; 21:51 'it only took us two queens to beat ding'.
